operatorNotes: All five planned items started and completed. Every run terminated COMPLETED with rootTerminalReason PAGE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, meaning each root reached the frozen 35-page attempt ceiling rather than running out of frontier.
No item produced fewer than 4 raw page-evidence rows, so the P5 arm that stopped the previous window never came close: the observed low-yield count was 0 of 5 against a threshold of 2.

Two items (P:33 and P:34) resolved their robots policy through a 301, which the landed fetch-policy-v6 continuation handled within its ceiling of one hop; the maximum robots attempt number observed anywhere was 2, and no ordinary page was ever retried.

P:33 is the only item whose formal SD7 count is a range rather than an exact value ([12, 15], from 3 short-text documents SD7 cannot resolve). The range is preserved complete, it does not cross the minimum of 4, and nothing was forced to an exact value. P:35 is also a range ([32, 34]) for the same reason.

The ten-entry replacement ledger was byte-identical at the window start, before and after every item, and at the window stop. Reserve positions 10 and 11 remain unassigned and the replacement obligations for slots 29 and 30 remain open exactly as the post-P24 adjudication left them.

Canonical Generation-1 inputs were held at 29 successes and 10 reserves consumed for every gate evaluation in this window, including after items that looked successful. Those are adjudication consequences, not execution consequences.

A Clamshell Sleep occurred at 2026-09-24T13:32:50Z, 8m43s after the terminal WINDOW_COMPLETE gate and after every run, page, candidate and sealed file had been written. The first validation gate reached its 120 quiet seconds but refused at the immediate pre-start recheck, so npm run validate was never invoked and the single-run authorisation was not consumed. The lid was reopened by the operator at 2026-09-24T15:35:54Z and the complete Git / database / ledger / binding / P7 / gate / sealed-file state was re-proved unchanged before the single governed validation run. The event is classified NON_CONTAMINATING_POST_TERMINAL_HOST_EVENT and altered no acquisition fact.
